articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today announced that it will report its first quarter 2023 earnings results on April 27, 2023, after the market closes. The Company’s earnings release and any supplemental information will be posted on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website – www.inventrustproperties.com/investor-relations/ . InvenTrust will host an earnings conference call to discuss the Company’s results and business highlights on Friday, April 28, 2023, at 10:00 a.m. ET. An archive of the webcast will be available on the Company’s website. articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today reported financial and operating results for the period ended March 31, 2023. For the three months ended March 31, 2023 and 2022, Net Income was $1.1 million, or $0.02 per diluted share, compared to Net Income of $9.5 million, or $0.14 per diluted share, respectively.
